method: Named region metadata/biome overlay on existing terrain, NOT a replacement for tile IDs. Proposed anchored Voronoi influence cells derived deterministically from world seed, with a reserved safe clearing and guaranteed walkable road links. Current main map generator does NOT implement this schema.

seededGenerationRules.regionMembership: One primary region ID for each cell, determined by nearest regional anchor with seed-derived low-amplitude jitter. Reserve R00 for immediate start radius; deterministic tie breaker by region ID. Do not persist 3072 redundant region IDs when derivable from seed + static region manifest.
seededGenerationRules.paths: Guarantee safe start ↔ each hamlet; supply an accessible route to each shrine and at least one ruin. Validate with BFS against actual walkable(s,x,y); WATER remains blocked until a separate tested bridge/ford feature.
seededGenerationRules.resources: At least one reachable food, wood, stone source from start and replenishable food over time; do not overwrite reserved landmarks with spawned berries.
seededGenerationRules.spawning: Existing cap 3 traveling NPC + 5 enemies; region-specific spawn constraints must not exceed global cap; no enemies inside safe start radius initially.
seededGenerationRules.compatibility: Keep source map tiles 0..10 and world 64x48 in v1. Region overlay is derived; any stored discovery IDs need optional field migration, bounds validation and old save load test.

regions.name: Hearthfield Clearing
regions.existingEvidence: Nim spawns at (32,24) with cleared nearby 7x7 and starter berry, forest and stone tiles
regions.minimumGameplay: Nim can eat, recover, gather, construct first camp and leave without a scripted player command

regions.name: Briarford Hamlet
regions.existingEvidence: Existing northwest village tile (25,21) and Toren the Squire's home anchor
regions.minimumGameplay: Toren patrols nearby; Nim may meet him without direct control; roads and resources remain accessible

regions.name: Emberwick Hamlet
regions.existingEvidence: Existing southeast village tile (37,27) and Ira the Apothecary's home anchor
regions.minimumGameplay: Ira can tend herbs when inspired; herb spawning has a cap and cannot overwrite water or landmarks

regions.name: Mossveil Wildwood
regions.existingEvidence: Current seed-noise forest tiles support wood/berry harvesting; this named regional identity is not coded
regions.minimumGameplay: Risk/reward forest with traversable clearings; Nim can harvest and safely retreat

regions.name: Stormstone Ridge
regions.existingEvidence: Existing stone terrain and boar enemy allow mining/danger, but no region-specific highlands logic exists
regions.minimumGameplay: Stone gathering is viable without forcing Nim through lethal bottlenecks

regions.name: Crownfall Ruins
regions.existingEvidence: Existing generic RUIN tiles, rumors and trap responses; Crownfall placement/name is a future overlay
regions.minimumGameplay: Ruins yield a finite clue; traps have avoidance logic; no endlessly-repeatable XP loop

regions.name: Oathkeeper Grove
regions.existingEvidence: Existing shrine at (20,31) and shrineVisited list; this area boundary and named grove are not implemented
regions.minimumGameplay: Visiting shrine rewards once per location; god Faith increase must remain bounded

regions.name: Moonwell Fen
regions.existingEvidence: Current WATER cells are impassable and rain/Bloom exist; a distinct wetland region does not yet exist
regions.minimumGameplay: Dry route reaches at least one meaningful landmark; no permanent soft-lock in water maze

phaseDefinitions.vertical_slice: R00+R01+R02 traversable and autonomous; 3 NPCs, resources, god powers, save
phaseDefinitions.region_expansion: R03–R07 fully differentiated and linked; ruins/holy sites tested
phaseDefinitions.later_world: Chunked additional maps only after hardware profiling; do not expand world to justify 1GB disk target

notes: Anchors are design coordinates for a proposed world layout, NOT guaranteed current existing POIs except explicit evidence. Do not infer new NPCs or simulated wildlife based on planned region inhabitants. 2–3 GB target PHONE RAM; game resident 128–192MiB preferred, soft 256MiB provisional.
